title: THSTI Notification 2026 - Apply Online for Various Research Scientist Posts
description: The Translational Health Science and Technology Institute (THSTI) has declared the official notification for the recruitment of various Research Scientist Jobs. Candidates who have qualified in Post Graduation, M.Pharm, or M.Sc can grab this chance and apply for the THSTI Notification 2026 . Here we have included the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts. Interested and eligible candidates can apply before the last...
